question: म्हजीं दोनूय फुफ्फुसां सादारण आसात?
expected: Are both my lungs normal? -> Yes, both lungs are clear
answer: Hoi, tumchim donuy fupsusam saf asat [clear].

question: म्हजें काळीज सादारण आकाराचें आसा?
expected: Is my heart of normal size? -> No, the heart is enlarged
answer:
Tumchea riportant tumchem kaalij vhodd asa (Cardiomegaly), ani tumchi hridyachi [cardiothoracic ratio] 0.60 zalea. 

Ho riportant na. Pleez tumchea doktrarak vichara.

question: फुफ्फुसाच्या कोणत्या भागांत उदक आसा?
expected: In which part of the lung is the fluid? -> Left lower part (left pleural effusion)
answer:
Reportant dixta zago (pleural effusion) bitor uduk/danv ani left lower zone asat. 

Hem tumchea reportant na. Krupain tumchea doktarak vicharat.

question: छातीचें कोणतें हाड मोडलां?
expected: Which bone of my chest is broken? -> Left 6th rib
answer: Tumchea [left 6th rib]chi haddi thoddi moddlea ([Undisplaced fracture of the left 6th rib]).

question: गांठ केदी व्हडली आसा?
expected: How big is the lump? -> About 1.5 cm
answer: तुمच्या रिपोटात गांठ 1.5 सेंमी [1.5 cm] व्हडली आसा.

question: म्हाका कर्करोग आसा?
expected: Do I have cancer? -> Not in the report
answer: He report aslyar hi mahiti na. Krupaya tumchea doktorak vicharat.
